description: Change the tenant's replenishment defaults (see get_replenishment_defaults): the default purchase lead time (days) and flat safety stock (days of demand) for items nothing more specific covers, tenant-wide and per item group. A group's default wins over the tenant's. Lead times or buffers typed on an item-warehouse, supplier defaults and purchase-order history keep taking precedence. Only the values you pass change; set clearLeadTimeDays / clearSafetyStockDays to inherit again. The preview shows each value before→after and how many items fall back to it. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential with Write + planning.execute and the Admin role.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

itemGroups.description: Item groups whose defaults to change; groups not listed are left alone.

clearLeadTimeDays.description: True to clear the group's lead-time default so its items use the tenant-wide one.

clearSafetyStockDays.description: True to clear the group's safety-stock default so its items use the tenant-wide one.

itemGroupId.description: The item group's id (from get_replenishment_defaults). Give this or itemGroupName.

itemGroupName.description: The item group's exact name, when the id is not known.

leadTimeDays.description: Default purchase lead time in days for the group's items, 0 to 3650.

safetyStockDays.description: Default flat safety stock in days of demand for the group's items, 0 to 365.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

tenant.description: Tenant-wide defaults to change; omit to leave them alone.

clearLeadTimeDays.description: True to clear the lead-time default so this scope inherits (group → tenant → 14-day system value).

clearSafetyStockDays.description: True to clear the safety-stock default so this scope inherits (group → tenant → 7-day system value).

leadTimeDays.description: Default purchase lead time in days, 0 to 3650.

safetyStockDays.description: Default flat safety stock in days of demand, 0 to 365.

name: set_replenishment_defaults
title: Set Replenishment Defaults
